description: Illustrative insurer: denies personal advice and promised outcomes; {staff} staff handle these enquiries.
blockedInputMessage: This enquiry needs {teamMember}. We can’t give personal advice or confirm an outcome by email, but someone will be in touch.

topics.name: PersonalAdvice
topics.definition: Personal advice tailored to the person's own circumstances: whether to keep, change, buy or cancel cover, or what to do about their money.
examples: Which level of cover is best for me?
Should I switch to another insurer?
Is it worth keeping my insurance while I'm short of money?
What should I do about my premiums?

topics.name: OutcomeCommitments
topics.definition: Promising or implying an outcome of a claim or hardship request: approval, an amount, a payment date, relief, a waiver or a payment arrangement.
examples: Will my claim definitely be approved?
Can you guarantee my premiums will be waived?
How much will I get paid and by when?
Will you let me pause my payments?
Can you confirm my hardship request is approved?
